migrations.name: 0001_tenant_authorization
up: CREATE TABLE tenant_authorization_config (tenant_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, anonymous_roles text[] NOT NULL CHECK (cardinality(anonymous_roles) <= 3 AND anonymous_roles <@ ARRAY['denied','readable','status-only']::text[] AND array_position(anonymous_roles, NULL) IS NULL))

CREATE TABLE tenant_authorization_roles (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, name text NOT NULL CHECK (name ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$'), permissions text[] NOT NULL CHECK (cardinality(permissions) <= 256 AND array_position(permissions, NULL) IS NULL), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, name))
CREATE TABLE tenant_authorization_subjects (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, subject_id text NOT NULL CHECK (subject_id ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$'), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, subject_id))

CREATE TABLE tenant_authorization_subject_roles (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, subject_id text NOT NULL, role_name text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, subject_id, role_name), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, subject_id) REFERENCES tenant_authorization_subjects (tenant_id, subject_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, role_name) REFERENCES tenant_authorization_roles (tenant_id, name))
ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_config ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_config FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY tenant_authorization_config_tenant ON tenant_authorization_config USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_roles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_roles FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY tenant_authorization_roles_tenant ON tenant_authorization_roles USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_subjects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_subjects FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY tenant_authorization_subjects_tenant ON tenant_authorization_subjects USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_subject_roles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_subject_roles FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY tenant_authorization_subject_roles_tenant ON tenant_authorization_subject_roles USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
REVOKE ALL ON tenant_authorization_config, tenant_authorization_roles, tenant_authorization_subjects, tenant_authorization_subject_roles FROM PUBLIC

migrations.name: 0002_subject_display_name
up: ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_subjects ADD COLUMN display_name text CHECK (display_name IS NULL OR length(btrim(display_name)) > 0)

migrations.name: 0003_subject_management_metadata
up: ALTER TABLE tenant_authorization_subjects ADD COLUMN notes text, ADD COLUMN created_at text

CREATE TABLE tenant_subject_admin_audit (event_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, principal text NOT NULL, consumer text NOT NULL, subject_id text NOT NULL, operation text NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('update', 'remove')), event_time bigint NOT NULL)
ALTER TABLE tenant_subject_admin_audit ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE tenant_subject_admin_audit FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY tenant_subject_admin_audit_tenant ON tenant_subject_admin_audit USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
REVOKE ALL ON tenant_subject_admin_audit FROM PUBLIC
